content.guideline_title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

sections.section_title: Treatment of AF After Cardiac Surgery
sections.key_point: Preoperative and postoperative strategies are discussed for preventing atrial fibrillation, including the use of β-blockers, amiodarone, and colchicine.

sections.section_title: Prevention of AF After Cardiac Surgery
sections.key_point: Practices such as β-blockers as a coronary surgery quality metric and the use of interventions for postoperative AF are highlighted.
Studies such as CAST and PAPABEAR provide evidence on managing AF with various pharmaceutical interventions.

genes.context: Developed in partnership between the Pediatric and Congenital Electrophysiology Society (PACES) and the Heart Rhythm Society (HRS).
PACES/HRS expert consensus statement on the recognition and management of arrhythmias in adult congenital heart disease.
